title: PostgreSQL + Linux | Clean Interactive Monitoring
description: Clean time-series dashboard. All time-series metrics use line/bar charts rather than gauges, preventing one gauge per timestamp. Four tabs: Overview, PostgreSQL, Linux Server, Exporter & Runtime.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_exporter_last_scrape_error" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_activity_count" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
